{"title":"Google Health","description":"Google Health as a universal on-ramp: an aggregator whose events carry the origin app/device in `vendor`, plus first-party Pixel Watch / Fitbit metrics.","defaults":{"dataSources":{"ds.search":{"options":{"queryParameters":{"latest":"$global_time.latest$","earliest":"$global_time.earliest$"}}}},"visualizations":{"global":{"showProgressBar":true}}},"inputs":{"input_global_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"global_time","defaultValue":"-30d@d,now"},"title":"Time Range"},"input_person":{"type":"input.dropdown","title":"Person (temp)","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_person_list"},"options":{"token":"person","selectFirstSearchResult":true},"encoding":{"value":"primary.person_id","label":"primary.person_name"}}},"dataSources":{"ds_person_list":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"| tstats count where `widx` by person_id
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name splunk_user
| eval person_name=coalesce(person_name, person_id)
| eval is_self=if(splunk_user=="$env:user$",0,1)
| sort is_self person_name
| table person_id person_name"},"name":"People"},"ds_g_total":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:* person_id="$person$"
| stats count as v"},"name":"Total Google events"},"ds_g_vendors":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:* person_id="$person$"
| stats dc(vendor) as v"},"name":"Distinct origin vendors"},"ds_g_types":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:* person_id="$person$"
| stats dc(sourcetype) as v"},"name":"Distinct data types"},"ds_g_fresh":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:* person_id="$person$"
| stats max(_time) as m
| eval age=now()-m
| eval v=case(isnull(m),"—",age<3600,round(age/60,0)." min ago",age<86400,round(age/3600,0)." hr ago",true(),round(age/86400,0)." d ago")
| table v"},"name":"Freshest sync"},"ds_g_origin":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:* person_id="$person$"
| stats count as events dc(sourcetype) as data_types latest(_time) as last by vendor
| eval last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| sort - events"},"name":"Origin breakdown"},"ds_g_volume":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:* person_id="$person$"
| timechart span=1d count by vendor"},"name":"Volume by origin"},"ds_g_datatype":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:* person_id="$person$"
| eval data_type=replace(sourcetype,"google:","")
| stats count as events by data_type vendor
| sort data_type - events"},"name":"Data type by origin"},"ds_g_origin_x":{"type":"ds.chain","options":{"extend":"ds_g_origin","query":"| stats count as c
| where c=0
| eval msg="No Google Health events in range"
| table msg"}},"ds_g_volume_x":{"type":"ds.chain","options":{"extend":"ds_g_volume","query":"| stats count as c
| where c=0
| eval msg="No Google Health events in range"
| table msg"}},"ds_g_datatype_x":{"type":"ds.chain","options":{"extend":"ds_g_datatype","query":"| stats count as c
| where c=0
| eval msg="No Google Health events in range"
| table msg"}},"ds_n_steps":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:steps person_id="$person$"

| stats sum(steps) as v
| where isnum(v)
| eval v=round(v,0)"},"name":"Steps today (native)"},"ds_n_bpm":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=google:heart_rate person_id="$person$"
